features.notes: configs/rules/welcomes/users/blacklist/groups import, idempotent; randomdatabase needs a Telegram-download backfill

features.title: Join captcha

features.title: Anti sticker spam

features.title: Admin configuration menu
features.notes: QA says /config, v1 ships /configurar - both must resolve

features.title: Block listed users from joining
features.notes: external cas.chat + burrbot need timeout and circuit breaker

features.title: Language selection
features.notes: QA describes a web settings page; v1 only has the in-chat menu

features.title: Per-event bot skins
features.notes: one process serves every skin; cb_core/skins.py adds the two behavioural forks v1 keys on is_alternate_bot (intro animation, fun-override flair) plus the per-skin asset override tree; all 5 personas configured (0007). Handler packs remain platform_tenancy's open item - see docs/contracts/core_botskins.md

features.title: Roll an n-sided die
features.notes: QA says 'roll 6'; v1 ships /dado and /d<N> - alias table already covers both

features.title: Ship two members
features.notes: landed the member registry (cb_core/members.py) it needs; QA's single-tagged-user scenario describes behaviour v1 never had - see docs/contracts/fun_ship.md

features.title: Random cause of death
features.notes: image pool only ever lived in v1's private GCS bucket, never checked in - see .specs/features/fun_death/spec.md

features.title: Meme generator
features.notes: v1's 97kB metadata CSV ships as package data, its 110MB of templates go to object storage via `cb.py meme-seed`; Pillow compositing in cb-worker; v1's roster fallback was dead code and its empty-pool branch a NameError, both fixed - see docs/contracts/fun_meme.md; QA authored (4 scenarios)

features.title: Battle poll
features.notes: two-people shape ships (roster + getUserProfilePhotos, no scrape); one-tag/self shapes blocked on the Fight/ GCS export, same as fun_death

features.title: Random media from the group
features.notes: MediaService.random() done and tested; handler not written

features.title: Partnered convention posters
features.notes: same GCS blocker as fun_death: every branch reads a Countdown/* prefix (Miscellaneous.py:18-22) and the single send_photo is unconditional. /trex is spec'd in QA but missing from v1 - net-new

features.title: Today's birthdays
features.notes: both v1 shapes: the manual command, and the daily every-group broadcast - whose caller turned out to be COOKIEBOT.py:333-339 (the message handler's finally, on the first update of a new UTC day), not a scheduler. v2 runs it as a cron with one deferred job per group instead of v1's sleep(3) loop (D8)

features.title: Upcoming birthdays
features.notes: not group-scoped, matching v1 exactly - see docs/contracts/util_nextbirthday.md

features.title: Ping every member
features.notes: batched roster read replaces v1's per-user backend call; fan-out moved to cb-worker

features.title: Call the admins
features.notes: group ping on the reply path; DM fan-out to every admin in cb-worker

features.title: Rewrite social links
features.notes: rewrites the 3 hosts v1 actually rewrites; vm.tiktok.com short links need a redirect resolve

features.title: YouTube search
features.notes: search + reply moved to cb-worker; v1's googleapiclient call had no timeout at all

features.title: Identify music in voice notes
features.notes: passive, off by default, breakered cb-worker job; shazamio-core segfaults on py3.14 so the recogniser is AudD's documented API behind a swappable seam - see docs/contracts/core_musicdetection.md; QA authored (5 scenarios)

features.title: Cross-group post forwarding
features.notes: scheduled_posts replaces Publisher.db; approve press now authorised by chat

features.title: Receive forwarded posts
features.notes: auto-forward prompt; must stay registered ahead of fun_random

features.title: Delete scheduled reposts
features.notes: QA says /deletereposts, v1 ships /deleteposts

features.title: Giveaways
features.notes: two distributed tables replace Giveaways.db; v1's /giveaway never completed (json.loads on a de-quoted callback payload) and its enter button was admin-only - both fixed, see docs/contracts/x_giveaways.md; QA authored, not ported (10 scenarios)

features.title: Conversational AI replies
features.notes: langchain provider behind the router, tenant budget cap, v1's per-user streak on a new cache.bump_clamped primitive, per-group rate limit; QA authored, not ported (7 scenarios) - see docs/contracts/x_conversational_ai.md

features.title: Voice transcription
features.notes: shape (a) ports the voice-to-AI sub-step; shape (b) is a net-new /transcribe command with no v1 equivalent; QA authored, not ported (5 scenarios) - see docs/contracts/x_speech_to_text.md

features.title: Reverse image search
features.notes: v1 handed SauceNAO a Telegram file URL carrying the bot token (D-RS-1); v2 uploads the bytes instead

features.title: Media distortion
features.notes: branch chain on the reply path, carve + ffmpeg in cb-worker behind a real semaphore (D3) with per-call temp dirs (D4); v1's video/GIF arms are unreachable and stay disabled; seam carving over numpy replaces ImageMagick liquid_rescale - see docs/contracts/x_distortion.md; QA authored (12 scenarios)

features.title: Owner-only operations
features.notes: private-chat only and gated on CB_OWNER_ID; /grupos is one paged message instead of v1's one getChat + one sendMessage per group (D11) and /broadcast is a cb-worker fan-out instead of a sleep(0.5) loop on the handler thread (D8); /stop and /restart answer a refusal rather than os._exit-ing one of N replicas - see docs/contracts/x_owner_commands.md; QA authored (9 scenarios)

features.title: Per-group custom commands
features.notes: same GCS blocker as fun_death, and worse: the command *names* are the bucket's Custom/ folder names (Miscellaneous.py:23), so without the export there is not even a trigger list. Still the seed of tenant handler packs once the assets land

features.title: Telegram-login JWT for the web console
features.notes: D7 fixed: the RSA key is configured or generated once into signing_keys (migration 0008), so it survives a restart and every replica shares it - v1 generated one per gunicorn worker per start and published only the answering worker's in its JWKS. Also D-WL-2: v1's pop('hash') meant only the first of its five bot tokens could ever sign anyone in. auth_date enforcement is written but off by default (the WebHub renews by replaying the payload) - see docs/contracts/x_webhub_login.md. No QA scenario: the feature has no Telegram surface

features.title: Per-group analytics endpoints
features.notes: rollup tables exist; no HTTP surface yet

defects.text: Write calls share the read memo-cache; duplicate writes silently no-op
Busy-wait spin lock serialises all media distortion
Fixed temp filenames raced across 50 threads
JWT signing key regenerated on every restart
sleep() in a loop over every group, on a worker thread
No index on Event.groupId, User.username, User.birthdate
Actuator health and metrics exposed anonymously
